description_en: Batch updates the start node and end node of specified edges in a specified task flow
description_zh: 批量更新指定任务流的指定边的起点节点和终点节点
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise update-task-flow-edges --dag-id 15000 --edges NodeFrom=44000 NodeEnd=44000 Id=24000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTaskFlowEdges

parameters.help_en:

You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the end node of the edge

fields.help_en: The ID of the start node of the edge
